title: How we generate addresses and prevent abuse
excerpt: Every address is 10 characters of cryptographically strong randomness, and the service is receive-only by design. Here is how generation and abuse prevention work.
meta_title: How we generate addresses and prevent abuse
meta_description: Why guessing an active address is impractical — 36^10 combinations, 10-minute lifetimes, per-IP rate limits — plus reserved prefixes, bans, and our Terms.
